framing.primary_status: The full Masoretic reading stream remains the primary analysis and includes Biblical Aramaic.
framing.purpose: Tests dependence of the primary result on the declared Aramaic spans; it does not posit that recurrence should be limited to Hebrew.
framing.complementary_check: Aramaic-span descriptive check using the same frozen geometries, fixed before inspecting the language-layer results after the conceptual clarification that Aramaic passages may also sustain recurrence.

hard_gap_rule.definition: Each contiguous retained-language run is a separate computational run. No motif, window, analysis block, 8-word fragment, 128-word evaluation block, or permutation crosses a language gap.
hard_gap_rule.grid_origin: The frozen offset/phase grid is applied independently from the start of each contiguous language run; results are pooled over eligible complete blocks/runs without changing any geometry.
hard_gap_rule.spatial_permutation: For each seed, fragment shuffling is performed independently inside each contiguous language run. Runs are never shuffled across a language gap.
